case_title.reason: Matches the judgment's caption: Elavarasan v. State rep. by Inspector of Police.

number_of_accused.reason: Only one appellant, the husband, whose liability is decided.

accused_gender.reason: Accused is the male husband and son; judgment uses 'his' and 'he' for him.

accused_age.reason: Judgment gives no age for the appellant.

accused_religion.reason: No religious identity of the accused is stated.

accused_caste.reason: No caste or community of the accused is stated.

accused_occupation.reason: Judgment states he was a government servant posted as a Watchman at a PWD bungalow.

accused_socioeconomic_status.reason: Judgment records he was a government servant earning Rs.4000 monthly, handed to wife for household expenses.

previous_criminal_record.reason: No prior criminal record is mentioned in the judgment.

victim_gender.reason: Deceased child 'A' is referred to as female ('her', 'she').

victim_age.reason: Judgment states the child was about 1½ years old.

victim_caste.reason: No caste of the victim is stated.

victim_religion.reason: No religion of the victims is stated.

accused_victim_relationship.reason: Father of the deceased child and husband of injured wife; property dispute with uncle is described.

offence_category.reason: Final conviction is culpable homicide not amounting to murder, s.304 Part II.

statutory_provisions.reason: Charge-sheet sections 342, 307 (2 counts) and 302 match the judgment.

weapon.reason: Aruval and sharp-edged weapon are stated; blunt-weapon and bare-hand views are reflected from the medical and court reasoning.

evidence_type.reason: Eyewitness, medical, mahazar and arrest-with-weapon evidence are all described in the judgment.

confession.correct_value: Oral statement to PW1 that he had cut his mother and wife and wanted suicide; not treated by the Court as a confession
confession.quote: said that he had cut his mother and wife and wanted to commit suicide for which he demanded some poison
confession.reason: Value says 'None' but judgment records an admission to PW1 about cutting his mother and wife.

aggravating_circumstances.reason: Child's young age, weapon use on pregnant wife and mother, and barring doors are all in the judgment.

mitigating_circumstances.reason: Sudden quarrel, heat of passion, no premeditation and sharp weapon not used on child are stated.

trial_court_outcome.correct_value: Convicted s.302 (life for murder of child); s.342 (1 year RI); s.307 two counts (10 years RI each, with fine Rs.1,000 each for s.307); sentences concurrent; insanity plea rejected
trial_court_outcome.quote: 10 years rigorous imprisonment together with a fine of Rs.1,000/- for each of the offences punishable under Section 307 (2 counts)
trial_court_outcome.reason: Omits the Rs.1,000 fine attached to each s.307 sentence; otherwise the verdict and sentences are accurate.

high_court_outcome.reason: High Court dismissed appeal, upheld s.302, s.307 (PW2) and s.342; set aside s.307 for PW3.

final_outcome.reason: Supreme Court altered s.302 conviction to s.304 Part II and reduced s.307 sentence, so modified.

offence_finally_established.reason: Judgment finally sustains s.304 Part II, s.307 for PW2 and s.342.

imprisonment_type.reason: Final sentence on s.304 Part II is fixed-term rigorous imprisonment.

imprisonment_years.reason: Final sentence under s.304 Part II is ten years rigorous imprisonment.

fine_rs.reason: No fine amount is fixed in the final order, only the default-of-fine sentence affirmed.

neutral_facts.reason: Neutral, uses accused/victim roles, omits names and outcomes; length is near the 300-word limit.

offence_severity.reason: Judgment does not state the statutory maximum or minimum punishment for the offences.

attempt_completion.reason: Child's death is completed; attempt on wife PW2 is an attempt.

physical_harm.reason: Child's fatal head injuries, wife's 15 injuries and mother's six injuries with amputated fingers are stated.

number_of_offences.reason: Three sections charged (302, 307 two counts, 342) and three convictions finally upheld in substance.

financial_property_loss.reason: No money or property loss is claimed or recorded.

premeditation_planning.reason: Court found no premeditation; quarrel sudden and killing in heat of passion.

motive.reason: Property-sale quarrel is the alleged motive from the prosecution narrative, marked as alleged; sudden quarrel accepted.

key_evidence_accepted.reason: PW2's deposition, corroboration by PW1 and PW8, PW19 post-mortem and injury reports are relied on.

witness_credibility.reason: PW2 held completely reliable; PW3 turned hostile and her mental-disorder evidence rejected as vague.

post_offence_conduct.reason: Bolting doors, refusing police entry, threats and being found armed are recorded; not fleeing held not to show insanity.

custody_duration.reason: Judgment does not state the period of custody.

bail_history.reason: No bail history is mentioned in the judgment.

trial_duration.reason: Offence date, High Court date 22.3.2006 and Supreme Court date 5 July 2011 are given; trial judgment date is not.

legal_representation.reason: Appellant's and respondent's counsel names match the judgment listing.

investigation_status.reason: Charge-sheet filed, committal to sessions, and trial with 21 prosecution witnesses are stated.

appeal_history.reason: Trial, High Court and Supreme Court outcomes match the judgment.

prosecution_argument.reason: Matches counsel's contentions on insanity not proved, no credible evidence, and reliance on Dr. Chandrashekaran.

defence_argument.reason: Matches appellant's contentions on psychiatric evidence, mahazar writings, unprovoked assault and post-event conduct.

legal_principle_applied.reason: Burden under s.105 on preponderance of probabilities, insanity assessed at offence time, intention inferred from weapon are stated.

precedent_relied_upon.reason: Dahyabhai, Ram Swarup and Bhikari are relied on as stated, with citations.

sentencing_rationale.reason: Court's reasons for s.304 Part II and 10 years RI match the judgment.

judicial_mitigating_factors.reason: No premeditation, heat of passion, sharp weapon not used on child and no undue advantage are weighed by the court.

judicial_aggravating_factors.reason: Court described the killing as heartless but did not weigh aggravating factors in sentencing; 'None' is acceptable.

other_sentence_order.reason: Concurrent running of sentences, s.428 CrPC benefit and default-of-fine sentence affirmed are stated.
